title: [corporate-action-coverage] corporateActionCoverageRecords: characterization test for deduped sorted sessions, action counts and datasets
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for corporateActionCoverageRecords in src/corporate-action-coverage.ts: session dedupe and counts
- corporateActionCoverageRecords(["2025-10-15", "2025-10-14", "2025-10-15"], [{ effectiveDate: "2025-10-15" }, { effectiveDate: "2025-10-15" }, { effectiveDate: "2025-10-01" }], { provider: "p", source: "s", recordedAt: "t", datasets: ["stocks-splits"] }) is [{ schemaVersion: "corporate-action-coverage-v1", sessionDate: "2025-10-14", provider: "p", datasets: ["stocks-splits"], actions: 0, recordedAt: "t", source: "s" }, { schemaVersion: "corporate-action-coverage-v1", sessionDate: "2025-10-15", provider: "p", datasets: ["stocks-splits"], actions: 2, recordedAt: "t", source: "s" }]
- corporateActionCoverageRecords([], [{ effectiveDate: "2025-10-15" }], { provider: "p", source: "s", recordedAt: "t" }) is []

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v5): Peace's task (source: peace). corporateActionCoverageRecords is tested with one session and no actions; duplicate and unsorted sessions, per-session action counts (actions on other dates ignored), a datasets override and no sessions are untested; this pins them. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 0ab37c8 (Workspace main 1fbe917, live 28-rule approved list, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v5); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with corporateActionCoverageRecords stubbed); suite 614/614 with all sixteen new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
